description: This file defines a class RepairCommands within the SuiteCRM project, extending RoboTasks to implement various database repair and rebuild functions, including database synchronization, extension rebuilding, relationship rebuilding, and record normalization.

classes.name: RepairCommands
classes.description: A command class extending RoboTasks, providing methods to repair the database, rebuild extensions, rebuild relationships, and normalize record encodings within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: repairDatabase
methods.description: Synchronizes database tables with vardefs, optionally executing SQL queries or just outputting them.

methods.name: repairRebuildExtensions
methods.description: Rebuilds CRM extension files found in custom/Extension.

methods.name: repairRebuildRelationships
methods.description: Rebuilds relationships defined in module vardefs.

methods.name: repairNormalizeRecordEncoding
methods.description: Repairs record normalization, either asynchronously via job queue or synchronously, with options for date filtering and tracking.
